description:
Subject: Bad row detected by Snowplow Stream Enrich (v2.3.0)

At 2023‑08‑15T12:35:01Z the enrichment pipeline recorded a failure while processing the following payload:

`{"schema":"iglu:com.snowplowanalytics.snowplow/web_page/jsonschema/1-0-0","data":{"page_url":"https://example.com","page_title":"Example Page","event_ts":"2023-08-15T12:34:56Z"}}`

The error reported was: “Failed to parse query string parameters: unexpected character '&' at position 27”. This issue was generated by the **snowplow-stream-enrich** artifact, version **2.3.0**. Please investigate the malformed query string in the source event to prevent similar bad rows in the future.
